name: com.agentexplorio/agentexplorio
title: AgentExplorio
description: Search 2,000+ AI agents and MCP servers by task. Pricing, setup, reviews, verification. Read-only.

tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Find AI agents, MCP servers and agent tools that do a job. Describe the task in plain words (e.g. 'reply to customer emails for a dental clinic'). Optional filters narrow by industry, type, price, setup and integration. Results come from the AgentExplorio index with verification labels; unverified listings are labeled.

query.description: The task in plain words, e.g. 'book appointments for a hair salon'

industry.description: Industry slug to filter by, e.g. legal, healthcare, ecommerce-retail

type.description: Kind of listing: agent (does the task on its own), assistant (chat helper), mcp_tool (MCP server an AI can call), builder_tool (platform to build agents), workflow_template (ready-made automation)

setup.description: no_code for tools anyone can set up; developer for tools that need coding or API keys

works_with.description: An app or protocol the result must integrate with, e.g. Slack, HubSpot, WhatsApp, MCP

verified_only.description: true to return only listings AgentExplorio has verified

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1 to 20)

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Full public listing for one agent by slug: pricing, setup, integrations, industries, tasks, uptime, likes, reviews and verification.

slug.description: The listing's slug, as returned in search_agents results (e.g. the last part of its agentexplorio.com URL)

tools.name: compare_agents
tools.description: Side-by-side facts for 2 or 3 agents by slug.

items.description: A listing slug from search_agents results

slugs.description: Slugs of the 2 or 3 listings to compare
